description: Everything needed to review one application before it is sent: the packet revision and its approval, the documents (name, format, size, hash) and form answers it would send, open employer questions, every blocker in words, field errors and the public timeline. Use it when the user wants to check or fix an application that waits for review; use get_application for status alone and get_application_receipt for proof after sending. Pass job_id. Reads only: approving, answering and sending are done by answer_question, preview_application and apply_to_job.

job_id.description: A job id from search_jobs, get_job_from_link or list_applications.

name: get_application_review

answer.description: The answer the application sends, as the user gave it.

question.description: The employer's question as it was asked.

source.description: Where the answer came from, such as the profile field it was taken from.

blockers.description: Everything that stops this application from being sent, in words.

digest.description: The current packet's hash, when one exists.

events.description: The public timeline steps, oldest first.

items.description: One public step of the application's timeline.

event.description: The step, e.g. recorded, prepared or submitted.

status.description: The status the step left the application in.

additionalProperties.description: What is wrong with this form field.

field_errors.description: Form fields whose answers the review rejected, by field name.

job_id.description: The job id of this application.

packet.description: The packet the application would send, or null when none was built.

approved.description: Whether the packet is approved to send.

approved_at.description: When the packet was approved, ISO 8601.

created_at.description: When the packet was built, ISO 8601.

current.description: Whether this is the application's current packet revision.

documents.description: The documents the packet would send.

items.description: One document the packet would send.

format.description: The document's format, from its file name.

questions.description: The open question batches this application waits on.

items.description: A batch of open questions the employer's form raised for this application.

id.description: The batch id answer_question takes as batch_id.

items.description: One open question of this batch.

kind.description: The answer kind the form expects, e.g. text, choice or file.

options.description: The options the form offers; empty for an open-text question.

required.description: Whether the form requires an answer.

revision.description: The batch revision these questions belong to.

review_available.description: True when the application has a packet the user may review.

review_reasons.description: Why the application waits for the user's review.

items.description: One reason the application waits for the user.

revision.description: The current packet revision, when one exists.

stage.description: The hiring stage the employer's messages established, when known.

step.description: Where the application stands in ApplySent's pipeline.

uncertain.description: True when the send went out without a confirmed receipt.

title: Read application review
